prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: low-speed head-on collision in Katy, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported neck and back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1260; do not mention it.)
text: Officer's Narrative: On arrival at the scene in Katy, Texas, I observed two vehicles in the eastbound lanes with significant front-end damage to both. Driver 1 was operating a sedan northbound and stated that Driver 2, traveling southbound in a compact SUV, crossed the centerline while attempting to pass a slower vehicle. Driver 2 disputed this account, stating Driver 1 drifted into the opposing lane shortly before impact. Witness statements were inconsistent on the precise sequence. Both vehicles sustained damage consistent with a low-speed head-on impact, and both were drivable with assistance. A passenger in Driver 2's vehicle was not injured. Driver 1 reported pain in the neck and lower back and was assessed on scene by EMS, then transported for further evaluation as a precaution. No citations were issued at the time of the report pending further investigation. Road conditions were dry and visibility was clear. Photographs and measurements of the scene were taken and are attached to this report.
